validate.description: Validate all example JSON content against the fung_core contracts/*.schema.json schemas.

run_example.description: Run the cave_boss vertical-slice scene headlessly to completion via the SceneTree runner, using a fixed seed for reproducibility.

replay_check.description: Structurally validate that fung_core/examples/cave_boss/replay.json exists, parses, and has the required seed and final_hash fields. Does not yet perform full deterministic re-simulation.

gdscript_lint.description: Static structural checks over GDScript files (no Godot engine required).

python_tests.description: Run the Python tooling test suite (schemas, validators, exporters).

narrative_smoke_test.description: Standalone headless smoke test for the CutsceneDirector narrative system.

budgets.note: Soft budgets, not hard-enforced by CI yet. Match FungProjectSettings.get_default_budgets() in fung_core/godot_addon/fung_core/systems/core/project_settings.gd.

status.note: The godot_version-tagged commands (run_example, replay_check, narrative_smoke_test) have never been executed in any environment. No Godot 4.x binary was obtainable in the sandbox that built this addon (apt only has Godot 3, GitHub releases were network-blocked, no snap/flatpak/working Docker). They will be proven for the first time by the godot-checks job in .github/workflows/fung_core.yml. Until that job has gone green at least once, treat these commands as reviewed but unexecuted.
